title: swarm.Swarm
description:
A validated Swarm with its computed content-addressed ID.

Created by converting from [`SwarmBase`] via [`TryFrom`]. The conversion:
1. Validates and normalizes each agent
2. Merges duplicate LLMs (by full_id) and sums their counts
3. Sorts LLMs by full_id for deterministic ordering
4. Computes the swarm ID from the sorted (full_id, count) pairs

# Constraints

- Individual LLMs with `count: 0` are skipped
- Total agent count (sum of all counts) must be between 1 and 128

agents.description: The validated and deduplicated LLMs, sorted by full_id.

items.description:
Wrapper that adds fallback agents and a count to any agent type.

Used to specify how many instances of an agent to include in an swarm,
along with fallback agents to try if the primary fails.

count.description: Number of instances of this agent in the swarm. Defaults to 1.

fallbacks.description: Fallback agents to try if the primary fails.

id.description: The deterministic content-addressed ID (22-character base62 string).
